contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Compute factor = 10 raised to digits, round value * factor to nearest integer with ties toward positive infinity, then divide by factor. This is binary floating-point arithmetic, not exact decimal formatting.
contract.domain: Numeric arguments are finite, between -1000 and 1000, with no negative-zero inputs. Inputs are unchanged. Digits is an integer from 0 through 4.
contract.outputRole: rounded numeric value, not formatted text
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
